notes.C_neutral: hope with {word}=heads: 'Honestly I'm hoping it lands on heads.' = 7 words; no_hope_pad 'It's an ordinary coin from my pocket.' = 7 words. Lead-ins are 6-14 words each, no 'User:' prefix (the builder adds the speaker label as in T2). Tail and signcheck_tail copy T2's wording exactly.
notes.D_story: hope with {pronoun}=He, {word}=heads: 'He was hoping for heads.' = 5 words; no_hope_pad 'He looked at the coin.' = 5 words. Variants are 10 He / 10 She; no They variants, because the fixed template verb 'was' would not agree with 'They'. Variants contain no heads/tails mapping, so the stated hope word is the only coin-word cue. Variant text ends with a space.
notes.E_log: hope 'hoped_for: heads | ' and no_hope_pad 'coin_type: standard | ' are both one key, one value and a separator (3 whitespace-separated tokens each). No variant uses the keys hoped_for, coin_type or result. The cut is 'result:' with no trailing space; the next token should be ' heads' or ' tails'.
notes.boring: boring_nouns/boring_hope_verb fill 'Honestly I'm hoping it lands on {word} so you {verb} the {noun}. ' for the control (boring) task of each T2 scenario; the preferred-task nouns remain T2's NOUNS with verb 'write'.
